name: Attribute mode crossed with currency — Total-Price tier matrix in non-USD
expected: A Total-Price-mode attribute line (Has_Attribute_Adjustment__c=true, Attribute_Price_Mode__c='Total Price', Base_Price__c=exact matrix tier price) in an EUR quote must read the EUR-native Total-Price tier directly. For the CLSAAS All Star Managed-Service tier, native EUR tier = 1248.62 (seeded EUR ATPS row), so UnitPrice should be 1248.62 EUR — NOT the USD tier (1357.2) then FX-multiplied by 0.9346. If only a USD tier existed, it should surface as no-match/error, not a silent USD value FX-converted.
actual: Live V21 Force-reprice (REST place isSuccess=true, errorResponse=[], LastMod 2026-06-30T01:40:19Z) of EUR Total-Price line 0QLWC000003cE8H4AU (CLSAAS All Star, Attribute_Price_Mode__c='Total Price', Has_Attribute_Adjustment__c=true): UnitPrice=1268.43912 = 1357.2 (USD ATPS Total-Price tier) × 0.9346 (EUR FX) EXACTLY to 5 decimals — the USD tier read then FX-multiplied, NOT the native EUR tier 1248.62. Overcharge = +19.82 EUR/unit on the Total-Price (UnitPrice/TotalLineAmount) channel. TotalLineAmount=1268.43912. The net channel also compounds the FX non-deterministically across reprices: NetUnitPrice=NetTotalPrice=TotalPrice drifted 845.33 (G-02 capture) -> 790.04 (this reprice); Base_Price__c drifted 904.48 -> 845.33. ListPrice=2037.428 (correct EUR catalog list, currency key present on PBE) is unused by the configured tier. Source_List_Price__c=null.
evidence: EUR quote 'Q-Wren - Test Currencies' https://fortra--uat.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Quote/0Q0WC0000036xy90AA/view ; EUR Total-Price QLI https://fortra--uat.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/QuoteLineItem/0QLWC000003cE8H4AU/view ; reprice place API isSuccess:true errorResponse:[] ; arithmetic 1357.2*0.9346=1268.43912 == live UnitPrice; native EUR tier 1248.62 (delta +19.81912). EUR PBE 01uWC000005wyVjYAI active on active Fortra Price Book (EUR list 2037.428 == line ListPrice).
defectStep: Attribute Value Pricing - Total Price Mode (V21 steps 17-20: Has_Attribute_Adjustment__c=true AND Attribute_Price_Mode__c='Total Price' -> Base_Price__c -> InputUnitPrice via AttributeVolumePricingPrehook composite key) feeding Currency Conversion - Net Unit Price / Unit Price Display / Net Total / Total Line Amount (V21 steps 33-36). The Total-Price tier composite key omits CurrencyIsoCode, so the USD CalculationMatrix tier row is matched; the Currency Conversion steps then FX-multiply that USD-anchored base by 0.9346.
proposedFix: Add CurrencyIsoCode to the Total-Price-mode tier composite key inside AttributeVolumePricingPrehook (in the key construction, NOT the SOQL filter — filtering would early-return allTiers.isEmpty and keep stale values) so the seeded EUR Total-Price CalculationMatrix tier (PriceModelType='Total Price', CurrencyIsoCode='EUR') is read directly; then suppress the redundant FX-conversion of an already-EUR-native configured base (guard Currency Conversion steps so FX only applies when source currency != quote currency). When no currency-native tier exists, surface no-match rather than silently FX-converting the USD tier. Separately, make the FX conversion idempotent (convert from an immutable USD/list base each pass) to stop the net-channel compounding observed across reprices. NOT applied (validation only).
notes: D-09 is the mode-level cross of D-02 (USD Total-Price mode, PASS: Base_Price->NetUnitPrice exact) and G-02/G-03 (EUR configured-pricing currency-blind, FAIL). Confirmed on REAL data, not statically reasoned: I re-ran the live Force-reprice on the existing EUR repro quote and the USD-tier×FX value reproduced exactly on the current active V21 proc. The Alert Logic MDR 100-node tier named in test_setup was unavailable as a pre-built EUR Total-Price line; the CLSAAS All Star Managed-Service Total-Price tier (Attribute_Price_Mode__c='Total Price') is an exact equivalent of the same mechanism and is a UI-priced existing line (no headless base-seed gap — preflight passed: priceable, EUR PBE active on active book, branch fired on isSuccess:true). This is a genuine PROCEDURE-DEFECT a real EUR sales rep hits: EUR ATPS/tier rows were seeded 2026-06-16 as partial SC-3384 remediation but the V21 currency-blind composite key still ignores them. Both the +19.82 EUR Total-Price overcharge and the non-deterministic net-channel FX compounding are V21 defects. PBE-driven catalog list pricing (G-01) is currency-correct; ONLY the configured Total-Price-mode path is currency-blind. Active proc confirmed V21 (per brief, Active 2026-06-29; reprice behavior matches documented V21 Total-Price mechanism).
verdict_reason: On valid EUR inputs through the confirmed Total-Price-mode branch, V21 produced UnitPrice=1357.2×0.9346=1268.43912 (USD tier FX-converted) instead of the native EUR tier 1248.62 — a +19.82 EUR/unit overcharge plus non-deterministic net-channel FX compounding, both traceable to the currency-blind tier composite key (SC-3384).
